verdict.rationale: Lorikeet says you can train the agent on your brand guidelines (lorikeet-docs-25), and runs one agent across chat, email, voice and SMS (lorikeet-docs-31). Coach scores 100% of conversations against your quality standards (lorikeet-docs-9) and response guardrails can rewrite off-policy replies (lorikeet-docs-35), which indirectly supports consistency. Missing for 10: explicit tone/voice configuration controls, any evidence of multilingual support or voice consistency across languages, documentation showing how brand voice is enforced across topics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
